title: Saudades: história de menina e moça
summary: "Saudades: história de menina e moça" by Bernardim Ribeiro is a pastoral novel written in Portuguese and first published in 1554. There she finds happiness, but in brief time, everything changes. Now she mourns more for the joy she once had than the sorrow she endures.
